decision.reasoning: The issue content semantically represents an ORT 1.28.0 release-candidate announcement and publishes prerelease packages. Its repository is not the configured authoritative microsoft/onnxruntime source, so this decision is actionable only under explicit demo authorization. For the assumed Windows x64 standalone EP host role, Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime is the applicable native base runtime package.
